name: Smith Machine Reverse-Grip Bench Press
steps: Center a flat bench so the bar tracks over your lower chest and lie back with both feet planted.
Grasp the bar underhand just outside shoulder width, wrap your thumbs, set your shoulders against the bench and release the hooks.
Lower the bar slowly toward your lower chest while keeping your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Press the bar straight back up along the rails to full arm extension, then rerack securely when done.
tips: Stack your wrists over your forearms as you lower the bar.
Keep your elbows close to your ribs to protect your wrists and shoulders.
